# Hybrid Pro

> Hybrid Pro is a mobile-first Progressive Web App at https://app.hybridpro.in for workout logging, meal planning, muscle recovery, body composition, and AI coaching. Tagline: Train with clarity.

Hybrid Pro helps athletes know what they lifted, what they ate, and what still needs rest. The public marketing page is indexable. Signed-in training screens require an account and should not be treated as public documentation.

Brand: Hybrid Pro. Logo: https://app.hybridpro.in/company-logo.png. Locale: en-IN. Structured data: WebApplication (HealthApplication) on the homepage.

## Docs

- [Hybrid Pro homepage](https://app.hybridpro.in/): Public landing page and canonical product URL
- [Full agent context](https://app.hybridpro.in/full-llms.txt): Complete Hybrid Pro product brief for LLM / agent context windows
- [Open Graph image](https://app.hybridpro.in/opengraph-image): 1200×630 share image with the Hybrid Pro logo
- [Sitemap](https://app.hybridpro.in/sitemap.xml): Indexable URLs
- [robots.txt](https://app.hybridpro.in/robots.txt): Crawl rules for public vs signed-in routes

## Optional

- [PWA manifest](https://app.hybridpro.in/manifest.json): Installable app name, icons, and start URL
- [Company logo](https://app.hybridpro.in/company-logo.png): Official Hybrid Pro mark
- [Sign in](https://app.hybridpro.in/login): Account entry (email, OTP, or Google). Not for indexing.
